article: Introduction to writing and running Rust tests
scope: Compared the complete Japanese source and all twelve translations, Rust test semantics, sample code, Cargo output claims, metadata, and internal/external links. Executed the extracted success-case example with cargo test.
findings: Replaced stale Rust/Cargo version-specific transcript paths, timings, and panic format with version-neutral behavior descriptions.
Organized the example as a #[cfg(test)] unit-test module and used clear, conventional function/test names.
Explained that failed assertions mark a test FAILED and cause Cargo to return an error status.
Removed duplicate date fields while preserving the 2022 publication date and setting the editorial lastmod.
Added official Rust Book, Cargo Book, and Rust Reference sources.
